positioning_check: Short interest 1,128,880 shares at the 2026-09-15 settlement, +41.9% vs 08-31, 1.10 days to cover (Nasdaq, https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/SWMR/short-interest?assetclass=stocks); ~8 business-day publication lag, so the position carried into today's fall is not observable. 16,610,264 shares outstanding at the 2026-09-11 record date (PREM14A); founder/director Serhii Kupriienko holds 28.7% (4,674,528 shares) per 13D/A filed 2026-09-23. No option chain, so no skew.

findings.finding: An effective committed equity facility (Lucid Capital Markets, resale registration made effective 2026-09-18 after the 2026-09-16 POS AM) leaves ~2.35M of 3.0M shares unused, sellable at 98% of VWAP on any trading day including 2026-10-05.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The registration is effective (EFFECT 2026-09-18) and the issuer can put shares to Lucid daily at its discretion; Lucid resells into the tape, so a draw can hit the 2026-10-05 session. Not a discrete event, a standing seller.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 654,734 shares already sold through the facility for ~$27.2M (avg ~$41.5) during a period in which the stock fell from ~$60 to ~$15; draws are not separately announced, so no event-level reaction exists.
findings.why_not_priced: The facility has been known since June and is partly priced as a drift; what the close does not hold is the specific draw on 2026-10-05, which at ~1M shares a day of average volume could be a meaningful share of the session. If priced, the stock would not be at 1.05x volume with no news but already at a discount the facility cannot push through.

findings.finding: Post-lock-up insider supply: the 28.7% founder-director exercised 235,163 more options on 2026-09-21 (13D/A 2026-09-23), a Form 144 was filed 2026-09-16, and Nasdaq counts 5 insider sells in 3 months, so unlocked insider stock can be sold into the 2026-10-05 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Form 144 notices cover sales over the following 90 days, so the 2026-09-16 notice is live through the window; a sale on 2026-10-05 would be executable (though its Form 4 would publish after the window).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The two largest falls in the baseline (-18.8% 2026-09-14, -28.4% 2026-09-15) coincide with the lock-up window and the 2026-09-16 Form 144/2026-09-17 Form 4 sells.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the 13D/A states no present plans, and the insider sells are public. What remains is the chance of further unannounced sales on 2026-10-05; if priced away the stock would have steadied after the 09-15 lock-up flush, and it has instead fallen five more times.
